= indented-callout-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc
:word: expanded

== Name
indented-callout-subs - honor literal paragraph substitutions

== Synopsis

[subs=-callouts]
 S01 ordinary <1>
 S02 escaped \<1>
 S03 XML <!--1-->

//-

[subs=none]
 S04 <1> & {word} *literal*

//-

[subs="+quotes,+attributes,+macros"]
 S05 *bold* {word} https://example.org[link] <1>
 S06 _italic_ <!--2-->

<1> Enabled substitutions before the marker.
<2> Formatting with XML callout.

//-

[subs=callouts]
 S07 {word} *literal* <.>

<.> Callouts without other substitutions.
